name: Object Placer
description: Places units, items, doodads and destructables in the terrain editor, one at a time or scattered (forests), optionally respecting pathing.

mcpTools.name: list_placed
mcpTools.description: What's placed on the open map. Without id, player or an area: how many of each type. With one of them: each object with its number (for move_object and remove_objects) and position. Start locations are the id sloc.

all.description: List every object of the kind one by one, for whole-map checks, up to 20000. Without a filter you get a count per type.

kind.description: units (default) also has items and start locations; doodads also has destructables.

region.description: A region of the map, by name.

terrain.placement.respectPathing.description: Place objects only where their footprint is free: no cliffs, deep water, unwalkable ground or other objects.

terrain.placement.scatterDensity.description: How closely Scatter packs objects: 1 = as close as their footprints allow; 0.5 = half as many per area.
